capabilities: Index scripture references in every note
List notes citing the current note's passages
Map chapter coverage and verse connections
Create notes for passages that have none
extras: Desktop only. Bible translations are downloaded from bible.helloao.org as hidden copies; no telemetry or accounts. A hands-on tutorial demo vault is offered in the browser or in Obsidian.
problem: Notes on the same Bible passage are scattered through a vault, and finding them means searching each reference by hand.

relations.evidence: If you add a Bible to your vault and use Omnisearch, turn on Omnisearch's option to respect Obsidian's excluded files
the apps you want in the right-click menu and the pop-up: Logos, Bible Gateway, Blue Letter Bible, STEP Bible
index notes, aliases and Breadcrumbs properties

requires.name: Logos, Bible Gateway, Blue Letter Bible or STEP Bible

summary: Side pane that indexes Bible references across a vault and lists every note touching the passages in the current note.
